mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user (username, password, real_name, role, stu_or_job_no, phone, email, max_borrow_count, max_borrow_days, max_renew_count, fine_per_day, deposit, status, create_time) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{role}, #{stuOrJobNo}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{maxBorrowCount}, #{maxBorrowDays}, #{maxRenewCount}, #{finePerDay}, #{deposit}, #{status}, NOW())

where.if: AND (u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.stu_or_job_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.update: UPDATE t_user SET password = #{password} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_user SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_user SET deposit = deposit + #{delta} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_user WHERE role > 0
SELECT stu_or_job_no FROM t_user WHERE stu_or_job_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%') ORDER BY stu_or_job_no DESC LIMIT 1
